ImageDescription.value: 1917 ad for first issued record by the Original Dixieland Jass Band, as published in the New Orleans "Item" newspaper, 11 May 1917. It describes the music as being like "A brass band gone crazy!",  and states the selections are "played with a charming ferocity and penetration".
